title: Crab Derby, 2013 · before
logline: The day before the twenty-ninth: Wood asleep at 2 PM after a night shift, the blank flyer on the drafting table beside him, the pen capped. Maria at the garage door with the girl, looking in, deciding. The strip watches her decide.

panels.composition: The garage. WOOD asleep face-down on the drafting table, a blank flyer under his arm, the pen capped. BARNABY on the blanket.

image.prompt: a man asleep face-down on a drafting table with a blank sheet under his arm and a capped pen, an old dog on a blanket, black ink with one spot tone

panels.composition: The door: MARIA, eight months along, with the three-year-old, looking in.

image.prompt: a pregnant woman with a dark braid and a small girl at a garage doorway looking in, black ink with one spot tone

panels.composition: MARIA looking at the flyer under his arm. Deciding.

image.prompt: a pregnant woman looking thoughtfully at a blank sheet beneath a sleeping man's arm, black ink with one spot tone

panels.composition: Her hand sliding the flyer out from under his arm without waking him. The pen.

image.prompt: a woman's hand sliding a blank sheet out from under a sleeping man's arm and picking up a pen, black ink with one spot tone

art.line: razor-sharp, confident brush and ink; pristine perspective; crisp silhouettes; zero crosshatch in close-ups
art.palette: dailies: black ink, one spot tone at most. Sundays: wet-on-wet — gray-green moss, fog, rusted tin, bruised dusk
art.paper: bristol for dailies; 140 lb Arches cold-press for Sundays
